finding: The current exact-main public smoke can create a new GRAPH_RV intent, reserve broker capital, and leave a bundle RESTING while the trade tape is explicitly unhealthy and uninitialized. The persistent loop likewise keeps the recorder and broker alive and rebuilds relation intents without an admission-time call to the trade-recorder health validator. Runtime health/recovery and strategy admission are therefore separate contracts: the former is fail-closed, while tape-dependent Graph/RV execution evidence is not yet fail-closed at admission.
required_next_test: On common chronological public data, compare current admission with a tape-health-gated challenger. When recorder evidence is unhealthy, no new Graph/RV or other tape-dependent queue/joint-completion intent may reserve capital. After health recovers, admission may resume using candidate-specific queue, joint completion, partial-fill abort/unwind economics, and fill-conditioned PnL. Existing resting state must be handled separately without fabricating fills or violating state integrity.
